CardDescription.DefaultText: A clay jar marked with spirit signs and sealed with a spirit herb. Unlike a plain clay jar it takes a spirit essence, and nothing in it draws on the essence, so it does not fade there. Pour an essence in while your mind is open to the spirits, and later pour it into an amulet or a coat that can be enchanted.
